==Notes==
*Though pets move 25% faster than players, it is not counted against them when being given a movement speed bonus, effectively increasing them to be moving 56.2% faster than players, and conveniently helps to better place time sensitive pet attacks ([[Disrupting Lunge]] or [[Bestial Pounce]], for example).

==Trivia==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Call of Haste/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Call of Haste (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
